description.value: Corner Cafe is a casual breakfast and lunch spot serving the Cloverdale area of Surrey, blending Korean-inspired dishes (Cupbop, wonton soup) with classic cafe fare like club sandwiches and wraps. The owners emphasize simple, quality ingredients cooked well over elaborate presentation, creating a warm and unpretentious atmosphere. The cafe also offers online ordering and catering for group inquiries.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms the cafe's identity, address (#101-19415 56 Ave, Surrey, BC V3S 6K2), and phone number (604-532-8060). The site prominently features online ordering, indicating takeout is available. No cycling-specific amenities (bike rack, Wi-Fi, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags; OSM hours differ slightly from website hours (OSM shows closing at 15:00 Mon-Fri, website says 16:00, and website adds Saturday hours), flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM opening_hours shows closing at 15:00 Mon-Fri, but website states 16:00 Mon-Fri and also lists Saturday hours (9:30am-1:30pm) not present in OSM — OSM hours may be outdated.
No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi) confirmed from website or OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Corner Cafe is a legitimate operating business that could serve touring cyclists as a food stop, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from available evidence. On-site verification is needed before inclusion.
